description: This Java class, BuyDownFeeAmortizationUtil, provides utility methods for calculating amortization of buy-down fees for loan accounts, supporting strategies like equal amortization and considering adjustment transactions, maturity date, and currency.

classes.name: BuyDownFeeAmortizationUtil
classes.description: A utility class for calculating amortization of buy-down fees on loan accounts, supporting strategies like equal amortization. It contains static methods and is not instantiable.

methods.name: calculateTotalAmortizationTillDate
methods.description: Calculates total amortization amount till a specified date based on the buy-down fee strategy.

methods.name: calculateTotalAmortizationTillDateEqualAmortization
methods.description: Helper method to calculate amortization for the 'EQUAL_AMORTIZATION' strategy, iterating through adjustment transactions and adjusting unrecognized amounts.
